title: Persistent branches: main, arena-manager, arena/agent-01..10; temporary task branches
problem: The #256 branchPolicy allowed only main and arena-manager to persist, which conflicts with the ten persistent worker slots required by #259/#263.

options.summary: Persist main, arena-manager and arena/agent-01..arena/agent-10; task work on temporary arena/agent-XX/TASK-nnnn branches deleted after merge; Manager work on arena/manager/<slug>

rationale: Supersedes the #256 branchPolicy text for worker branches only; every other #256 rule (merged -> deleted, unmerged work -> PR, obsolete -> archive tag) still applies. The worker branches are created only after this governance change is merged to main and fresh-main verified.
